name: conexa
description: Convexa : super-app de campus (football, rencontres, talents, services, partenariats)

scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yaml --profile core --profile storage --profile observability up -d --wait
scripts.dev:down: docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yaml --profile core --profile storage --profile observability down
scripts.dev:reset: docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yaml --profile core --profile storage --profile observability down -v --remove-orphans && docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yaml --profile core --profile storage --profile observability up -d --wait
scripts.ci:guards: pnpm tools:check-ownership && pnpm tools:check-migrations && pnpm tools:check-contracts && pnpm tools:check-pii && pnpm tools:check-secrets && pnpm test:tools
scripts.verify: pnpm docs:verify && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
